sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1922058_kentik_0.KentikAPIUtilsAjax</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>KentikAPIUtilsAjax</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var KentikAPIUtilsAjax = Class.create();
KentikAPIUtilsAjax.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    // Start a new chat or update existing
    startOrUpdateChat: function() {
        var prompt = this.getParameter('sysparm_prompt');
        var incidentId = this.getParameter('sysparm_incident_id'); 
        var sessionId = this.getParameter('sysparm_session_id');
        
        var utils = new x_1922058_kentik_0.KentikAPIUtils();
        var finalPrompt = prompt;

        // If starting fresh, grab the alert context
        if (!sessionId) {
            var incGr = new GlideRecord('incident');
            if (incGr.get(incidentId)) {
                var allAlertsInfo = utils.getMultiAlertContext(incGr);
                finalPrompt = "I am investigating an incident. Here is the raw data from all related Kentik alerts:\n\n" + 
                            allAlertsInfo + "\n\n" +
                            "Question: " + prompt;
            }
        }

        var result;
        if (sessionId) {
            result = utils.updateChat(sessionId, finalPrompt);
        } else {
            result = utils.createChat(finalPrompt);
        }

        // Inject Base URL for the UI Link ---
        // result is expected to be an object: { id: "session_id", ... }
        if (result) {
            result.base_url = gs.getProperty('x_1922058_kentik_0.portal_base_url', 'https://portal.kentik.com');
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    },  

    // Check status (The Poller)
    pollChat: function() {
        var sessionId = this.getParameter('sysparm_session_id');
        
        gs.info("KentikDebug: Polling for Session ID: " + sessionId);

        if (!sessionId) {
            gs.error("KentikDebug: No Session ID provided to pollChat");
            return JSON.stringify({status: 'ERROR', error: 'No Session ID'});
        }

        var utils = new x_1922058_kentik_0.KentikAPIUtils(); 
        var results = utils.getChatResults(sessionId);
        
        return JSON.stringify(results);
    },

    postChatToWorkNotes: function() {
        var incidentId = this.getParameter('sysparm_incident_id');
        var notesText = this.getParameter('sysparm_notes_text');

        var incGr = new GlideRecord('incident');
        if (incGr.get(incidentId)) {
            // Using [code] tags would render formatting, but since we decided 
            // to stick to raw markdown, we'll keep it simple:
            var formattedNote = "Kentik AI Advisor Analysis:\n\n" + notesText;
            
            incGr.work_notes = formattedNote;
            var success = incGr.update();
            
            return success ? 'success' : 'error_updating_record';
        }
        return 'record_not_found';
    },

    type: 'KentikAPIUtilsAjax'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-24 15:20:29</sys_created_on><sys_id>245cc1c483244f503db35d70deaad375</sys_id><sys_mod_count>15</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KentikAPIUtilsAjax</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Kentik Integration" source="x_1922058_kentik_0">76d2ce9383dcc3503db35d70deaad3ae</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Kentik Integration">76d2ce9383dcc3503db35d70deaad3ae</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_245cc1c483244f503db35d70deaad375</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-28 09:50:53</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1922058_kentik_0.KentikAPIUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>KentikAPIUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var KentikAPIUtils = Class.create();
KentikAPIUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Core REST caller
     */
    callKentik: function(methodName, kentikId, payload) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('x_1922058_kentik_0.Kentik_API', methodName);
        
        r.setStringParameterNoEscape('base_url', gs.getProperty('x_1922058_kentik_0.api_base_url'));
        r.setStringParameterNoEscape('api_email', gs.getProperty('x_1922058_kentik_0.user_email'));
        r.setStringParameterNoEscape('api_token', gs.getProperty('x_1922058_kentik_0.api_token'));

	// Only set if alarmID is provided, otherwise it remains blank in the URL
    if (kentikId) {
        r.setStringParameterNoEscape('kentikId', kentikId);
    }

    if (payload) {
        r.setRequestBody(JSON.stringify(payload));
    }

        return r.execute();
    },

    /**
     * Condition check for the UI Action button visibility
     */
    shouldShowKentikButton: function(incidentGr) {
        var alertGr = new GlideRecord('em_alert');
        alertGr.addQuery('incident', incidentGr.getUniqueValue());
        alertGr.addQuery('source', 'Kentik');
        alertGr.setLimit(1); 
        alertGr.query();

        return alertGr.hasNext();
    },

    /**
     * Acknowledges all Kentik alerts linked to a specific incident.
     */
    acknowledgeAllRelatedKentikAlerts: function(incidentGr) {
        var results = {
            successCount: 0,
            failCount: 0,
            ids: []
        };

        var alertGr = new GlideRecord('em_alert');
		alertGr.addQuery('incident', incidentGr.getUniqueValue());
		alertGr.addQuery('source', 'Kentik');
		alertGr.query();

        while (alertGr.next()) {
            var ackResult = this.acknowledgeAlert(alertGr);
            if (ackResult.success) {
                results.successCount++;
            } else {
                results.failCount++;
            }
        }
        return results;
    },

	/**
     * Acknowledges Single Kentik alert
     */
	acknowledgeAlert: function(alertGr) {
		var results = { success: false, statusCode: 0 };
		
		try {
			var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
			if (!alarmID) return results;

			var response = this.callKentik('Acknowledge', alarmID, null);
			results.statusCode = response.getStatusCode();
			
			if (results.statusCode == 200 || results.statusCode == 201) {
				results.success = true;
				// also add a comment
				var user = gs.getUser();
				var userIdentifier = user.getDisplayName() + " (" + user.getName() + ")";
				var payload = { "text": "Acknowledged from ServiceNOW by " + userIdentifier };
				this.callKentik('Add Comment', alarmID, payload);
			}
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error("Kentik Ack Error for " + alertGr.number + ": " + e);
		}
		return results;
	},

	/**
     * UnAcknowledges Single Kentik alert
     */
	unAcknowledgeAlert: function(alertGr) {
		var results = { success: false, statusCode: 0 };
		
		try {
			var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
			if (!alarmID) return results;

			var response = this.callKentik('UnAcknowledge', alarmID, null);
			results.statusCode = response.getStatusCode();
			
			if (results.statusCode == 200 || results.statusCode == 201) {
				results.success = true;
				// also add a comment
				var user = gs.getUser();
				var userIdentifier = user.getDisplayName() + " (" + user.getName() + ")";
				var payload = { "text": "UnAcknowledged from ServiceNOW by " + userIdentifier };
				this.callKentik('Add Comment', alarmID, payload);
			}
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error("Kentik UnAck Error for " + alertGr.number + ": " + e);
		}
		return results;
	},

     /**
     * Clear all Kentik alerts that point to this incident
     */
	clearAllRelatedKentikAlerts: function(incidentGr) {	
		var results = { success: false, ids: [] };

        // Direct query: Find alerts where 'incident' field matches this incident
        var alertGr = new GlideRecord('em_alert');
        alertGr.addQuery('incident', incidentGr.getUniqueValue());
        alertGr.addQuery('source', 'Kentik');
        alertGr.query();

		while (alertGr.next()) {
			// Get Alarm ID using our helper
			var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
			if (alarmID){
				results.ids.push(alarmID.toString());
			} 
		}

		// If we found IDs, send the structured body
		if (results.ids.length > 0) {
			var payload = {
				"alert_ids": results.ids // This matches the 'repeated string alert_ids'
			};

			var response = this.callKentik('Clear Alerts', '', payload); // Passing empty ID since IDs are in body
			if (response.getStatusCode() == 200 || response.getStatusCode() == 201) {
				results.success = true;
			}
		}
		
        return results;
    },

	/**
	 * Processes and sends a comment to Kentik
	 * @param {GlideRecord} incidentGr - The incident being updated
	 * @param {GlideRecord} alertGr - The specific alert to comment on
	 * @return {Object} - Result status
	 */
	syncComment: function(incidentGr, alertGr) {
		var result = { success: false, skip: false };

		// Get the latest Journal Entry (Comments)
		var lastComment = incidentGr.comments.getJournalEntry(1);
		if (!lastComment) {
			result.skip = true;
			return result;
		}

		// Clean the Journal Header (Removes "Date - User (Comments)\n")
		// This looks for the first newline and takes everything after it
		var cleanComment = lastComment.indexOf('\n') > -1 ? 
						lastComment.substring(lastComment.indexOf('\n')).trim() : 
						lastComment.trim();

		if (!cleanComment) {
			result.skip = true;
			return result;
		}

		// Get Alarm ID using our helper
		var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
		if (!alarmID) return result;

		var user = gs.getUser();
		var userIdentifier = user.getDisplayName() + " (" + user.getName() + ")";

		// Fire the REST call
		var payload = { "text": "Comment from ServiceNOW by " + userIdentifier + ": " + cleanComment };
		var response = this.callKentik('Add Comment', alarmID, payload);
		
		if (response) {
			result.status = response.getStatusCode();
			result.success = (result.status == 200 || result.status == 201);
		}

		return result;
	},

	/**
	 * Links ServiceNow Incident details to a Kentik Alert
	 * @param {GlideRecord} incidentGr - The incident record
	 * @param {GlideRecord} alertGr - The alert record
	 * @return {Object} - Result status
	 */
	sendExternalContext: function(incidentGr, alertGr) {
		var result = { success: false, status: 0 };

		// Get Alarm ID using our helper
		var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
		if (!alarmID) return result;

		// Construct the URL and ID
		var instanceUrl = gs.getProperty('glide.servlet.uri');
		var incidentNumber = incidentGr.getValue('number');
		var incidentLink = instanceUrl + 'incident.do?sys_id=' + incidentGr.getUniqueValue();

		// Prepare the Nested Payload
		var payload = {
			"context": {
				"servicenow": {
					"incident_id": incidentNumber,
					"incident_url": incidentLink
				}
			}
		};

		// Fire the REST call
		var response = this.callKentik('Set Incident Details', alarmID, payload);
		
		if (response) {
			result.status = response.getStatusCode();
			result.success = (result.status == 200 || result.status == 201);
		}

		return result;
	},

	/**
	 * Internal Helper to parse the AlarmID
	 */
	_getAlarmID: function(alertGr) {
		try {
			var additionalInfo = alertGr.getValue('additional_info');
			var parsed = JSON.parse(additionalInfo);
			// Check for common Kentik JSON structures
			if (parsed.additional_content) {
				return JSON.parse(parsed.additional_content).AlarmID;
			}
			return parsed.AlarmID || parsed.alarm_id || "";
		} catch (e) {
			gs.error("Kentik ID Parse Error: " + e.message);
			return "";
		}
	},

	/**
	 * Create a new Chat Session
	 */
	createChat: function(userPrompt) {
		var payload = { "prompt": userPrompt };
		var response = this.callKentik('Create AI Chat', '', payload);
		return response ? JSON.parse(response.getBody()) : null;
	},

	/**
	 * Update an existing Chat Session (Follow-up questions)
	 */
	updateChat: function(sessionId, userPrompt) {
		var payload = { 
			"id": sessionId,
			"prompt": userPrompt 
		};
		var response = this.callKentik('Update AI Chat', '', payload);
		return response ? JSON.parse(response.getBody()) : null;
	},

	/**
	 * Get results of a session (Polling)
	 */
	getChatResults: function(sessionId) {
		// Note: 'Get_Chat' should have endpoint /ai_advisor/v202511/chat/${kentikId}
		var response = this.callKentik('Get AI Chat', sessionId, null); 
		return response ? JSON.parse(response.getBody()) : null;
	},

	/**
	 * Gathers additional_info from ALL related Kentik alerts
	 */
	getMultiAlertContext: function(incidentGr) {
		var masterContext = "--- START OF ALERT DATA ---\n";
		
		var alertGr = new GlideRecord('em_alert');
		alertGr.addQuery('incident', incidentGr.getUniqueValue());
		alertGr.addQuery('source', 'Kentik');
		alertGr.query();

		var count = 0;
		while (alertGr.next()) {
			count++;
			var alarmID = this._getAlarmID(alertGr);
			masterContext += "Alarm #" + count + ":\n";
			masterContext += alertGr.getValue('additional_info') + "\n\n";
		}

		masterContext += "--- END OF ALERT DATA ---";
		
		return (count > 0) ? masterContext : "No Kentik alerts found.";
	},
    type: 'KentikAPIUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-04-24 12:05:25</sys_created_on><sys_id>f93060c083e80f503db35d70deaad3dc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>33</sys_mod_count><sys_name>KentikAPIUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Kentik Integration" source="x_1922058_kentik_0">76d2ce9383dcc3503db35d70deaad3ae</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Kentik Integration">76d2ce9383dcc3503db35d70deaad3ae</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_f93060c083e80f503db35d70deaad3dc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-04-29 14:46:05</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
